# Abhay Gupta - Full Stack & AI Developer Portfolio

> Abhay Gupta is a Computer Science student at IIT Madras (BS) & SRIT (BTech), Full-Stack & AI Developer specializing in Computer Vision, Next.js, Python, and Multi-Agent Systems. HackSRIT'25 1st Prize Winner.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/): Portfolio homepage featuring skills, experience, achievements, and project highlights.
- [ReelsPro Project](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-reelspro.html): HackSRIT'25 1st Prize Winner AI Video Platform with Groq & Gemini AI moderation.
- [AgentX Travel India Project](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-agentx.html): Multi-Agent AI travel planning assistant built with Streamlit & LangChain.
- [Helmet Detection Project](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-helmet-detection.html): YOLOv11 real-time safety monitoring computer vision system with 95% accuracy.
- [EduPath Explorer Project](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-edupath.html): Vector embedding RAG course recommendation system.
- [JARVIS AI Assistant Project](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-jarvis.html): Voice-controlled productivity assistant built with Python speech recognition.
- [Machine Learning Projects Collection](https://www.abhaygupta6187.me/project-ml.html): Portfolio of 19+ Hugging Face spaces covering NLP, Healthcare AI, and Vision.
